Entries.Biography: Treyvon is Scarlett's father, Hank's husband, and the owner of 'Treyvon's Essentials' wholesale store in Grampleton. Hardworking, protective, and family-oriented, he balances running his business with cheering for Tunnelers gridball and taking care of his truck.

Hank.Heading: Hank
Hank.Description: Devoted husband; built a proud life and co-owns their home in Pondwood.

Scarlett.Heading: Scarlett
Scarlett.Description: Adored daughter; learning to grant her space as an independent adult despite his protective nature.

Marnie.Heading: Marnie
Marnie.Description: Key business partner; contracts milk and wool supply from her ranch for his wholesale store.

SpeechPattern.Heading: Speech Style & Mannerisms
SpeechPattern.Description: Friendly, practical, and grounded. Enjoys casual banter about sports, vehicles, and suburban life.

Hardworking.Heading: Driven Merchant
Hardworking.Description: Takes immense pride in maintaining his wholesale supply lines and providing for his household.

Loving.Heading: Protective Father
Loving.Description: Deeply devoted to his family's happiness and safety, always striving to support Scarlett's growth.

Entries.BiographyEnd: Treyvon spends his time managing his wholesale store, reading weekend comics, polishing his pickup truck, and supporting the Tunnelers gridball team.
